steps.title: Analyze build failure logs and manifest merger errors
steps.description: Examine the manifest merger log to locate missing name attributes and deprecated package declaration.

steps.title: Clean manifest XML package attribute
steps.description: Remove legacy package attribute from manifest root element in compliance with AGP 8.3.2 namespace rules.

steps.title: Reformat android:name attributes in AndroidManifest
steps.description: Ensure valid namespace declaration and standard android:name key attributes for permissions, activities, intent filters, and services.

steps.title: Validate build target SDK 34 and Java 8 compatibility
steps.description: Verify compileSdkVersion 34, targetSdkVersion 34, and Java 8 language target configuration in app build.gradle.

steps.title: Verify MainActivity launcher activity registration
steps.description: Confirm MainActivity is correctly configured with exported status and launcher intent category.

steps.title: Verify BackgroundAudioService foreground service type
steps.description: Ensure BackgroundAudioService is properly registered with mediaPlayback foreground service type.

steps.title: Audit watch history layout and list rendering
steps.description: Check HistoryActivity registration in manifest and verify SQLite database helper compatibility.

steps.title: Confirm media session and notification channel setup
steps.description: Verify background playback controls and notification permission handling in service and main activity.

steps.title: Validate layout resource IDs and vector drawables
steps.description: Check layout XML components and vector icon definitions for XML validity.

steps.title: Building BG Tube Player
steps.description: Final compilation and validation of clean AndroidManifest structure and release APK output.
